# Anatome

> Muscle group image generator API + ExerciseDB — Apache-2.0, hosted on Cloudflare Workers.

## What is Anatome?

Anatome renders colorable anatomical SVG diagrams of the human body over a simple
HTTP API. It also bundles an exercise database (873 CC0 exercises pre-mapped to
23 muscle slugs) and implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so AI agents can
call it as a tool with zero additional integration work.

**Use it if you need to:**

- Embed a muscle-group diagram in a fitness app (`<img src="https://api.anatome.dev/generateImage?...">`)
- Show which muscles a workout session hit (session heatmap)
- Let an AI agent search or look up exercises with muscle-activation context
- Proxy exercise reference photos (CC0) without hitting GitHub raw URLs

## Live API

Base URL: `https://api.anatome.dev`

All endpoints are free to use within the fair-use rate limit (1 000 requests/IP/day).
For higher volume use the [RapidAPI plan](https://rapidapi.com/anatome/api/anatome)
(300 req/mo included, then $0.001/req).

## Key endpoints

```
GET  /generateImage   Render a colorable SVG muscle diagram
POST /generateImage   Same, via JSON body
GET  /workoutImage    Session heatmap SVG (stacked muscle activation across exercises)
GET  /searchExercises Search 873 exercises (name/muscle/equipment/level filters)
GET  /getExercise     Fetch a single exercise by name, ext_id, or random
GET  /resolveExercise Map an exercise name → muscle layers
GET  /exerciseGif     2-frame demo GIF for an exercise
GET  /exerciseImage   CC0 reference photo from free-exercise-db, proxied
GET  /listMuscles     List all 23 muscle slugs with anatomical names
GET  /muscleInfo      Stats for a single muscle slug
GET  /listEquipment   List all equipment types in the database
POST /mcp             MCP JSON-RPC endpoint (7 tools)
GET  /openapi         OpenAPI 3.1 spec
```

## MCP tools (for AI agents)

| Tool | What it does |
|------|-------------|
| `generate_muscle_image` | Render a highlighted muscle SVG |
| `list_muscles` | List all 23 muscle slugs |
| `resolve_exercise` | Map an exercise name → muscle layers |
| `search_exercises` | Search the 873-exercise database |
| `get_exercise` | Fetch a full exercise record |
| `get_exercise_gif` | Get the demo GIF URL for an exercise |
| `workout_image` | Session heatmap SVG from a list of exercises |

MCP config (add to `claude_desktop_config.json` or equivalent):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "anatome": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://api.anatome.dev/mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Quick example

```bash
# Highlight chest + triceps on a male dual-view diagram
curl "https://api.anatome.dev/generateImage?layers=DC2626:chest|F59E0B:triceps&output=raw" -o diagram.svg

# Session heatmap for a push day
curl -X POST https://api.anatome.dev/workoutImage \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"exercises":["bench press","overhead press","tricep pushdown"],"view":"front"}'

# Search exercises that target the chest
curl "https://api.anatome.dev/searchExercises?muscle=chest&limit=5"
```

## Repository layout

```
api/          Cloudflare Workers API (Hono) — deploys via wrangler
src/          React/Vite marketing + playground (Base44)
base44/       Base44 configuration + functions
```
